ideation.title: Brainstorming
ideation.purgeHelp: Permanently delete “{title}” and its ideas and history? Existing recovery archives keep their own copy. This cannot be undone here.
ideation.conflictHelp: Your text is kept above. Compare it with the saved text below before choosing.
ideation.sessionHelp: Start with a title. The rest is optional, and you decide how to work.
ideation.responsibilitiesHelp: Only current project editors can take these roles. Existing private ideas remain private.
ideation.recoveredDraftsHelp: Copy the text you want to keep into a new or existing idea after checking the current session. It has not been applied automatically.
ideation.archivedHelp: This session is archived. You can read its ideas.
ideation.sessionMissingHelp: Choose a session from the list. Sessions replaced by a project restore can be recovered from the Replaced view.

errors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Your unsaved text is kept here. Try refreshing the board.
errors.offline: The connection was interrupted. The result is unknown; retrying an idea or publication uses the same request. Your text is kept here.
errors.validation: Check the fields. A session needs a title; an idea needs text. Keep titles under 160 characters and idea content under 64 KB.
errors.stale_configuration: The session settings changed while you were writing. Close this form and review the new settings before creating the idea. Your text is kept for recovery.
errors.stale_revision: Someone changed this session. Close and reopen its settings to review the current version.
errors.stale_board: The board changed or reconnected. Review the refreshed session before saving again.
errors.unauthorized: Your access changed. Refresh the board to check your current permissions.
errors.not_found: This item is not available to you in this session.
errors.session_archived: This session is archived. Reopen it before adding or editing ideas.
errors.invalid_parameters: Some values are invalid. Reopen the form and try again.
errors.ideation_recovery_too_large: This recovery exceeds the supported size. Keep your existing archive and review replaced sessions before trying again.
errors.stale_reveal: The selected revisions are no longer eligible. Close this dialog and review a new selection.
errors.session_creation_unknown: The connection was interrupted while creating the session. Check the session list and reload before creating another.
errors.stale_canvas: Someone else moved this note. Its position has been refreshed.
errors.save_before_connect: Write something and let the note save before connecting it.
errors.session_private: The facilitator controls this session’s reveal.
errors.stale_deletion: This deletion has changed. Refresh the board before trying again.
errors.undo_unavailable: This action is no longer available because the note changed. You can continue undoing earlier actions.
errors.selection_too_large: This selection is too large. Select fewer notes and try again.
errors.session_not_replaced: This session has not been replaced and does not need recovery. Refresh the session list.
errors.round_already_active: A round is already in progress. Close it before starting another.
errors.round_not_active: This round is no longer in progress. Review the current round.
errors.invalid_round: This round is unavailable. Refresh the board and review its rounds.
errors.round_not_started: This round has not started. Start it before contributing notes.
errors.round_closed: This round is closed. Prepare another round to continue.
errors.round_not_found: This round is no longer available. Refresh the board.
errors.round_not_planned: Only a prepared round can be changed or cancelled. Review the current round.
errors.timer_already_running: A timer is already running or paused. Review the current timer.
errors.timer_not_running: This timer is no longer running. Review its current state.
errors.timer_not_paused: This timer is no longer paused. Review its current state.
errors.timer_expired: This timer has ended. You can start another one.
errors.stale_timer: Someone changed the timer. Review its current state before trying again.
errors.invalid_timer_duration: Choose a duration from 15 seconds to 24 hours.
errors.invalid_timer_options: Review the actions selected for the end of the timer.
errors.contributions_closed: New contributions are closed. Your draft is kept here; retry when the facilitator reopens contributions.
errors.timer_reveal_requires_private: Start private mode before choosing to reveal notes when time ends.
errors.timer_not_found: This timer is no longer available. Refresh the board.
errors.invalid_timer_version: The timer state is invalid. Refresh the board and try again.

ideation.legacySnapshotHelp: Older snapshots (format 2) have no brainstorming data. They can only be restored when all sessions are replaced; replaced history is kept.

canvas.label: Brainstorming canvas
canvas.emptyHelp: Double-click anywhere to write. Move notes freely and connect ideas as they take shape.
canvas.dashboardHelp: A space for your team to explore ideas and pick up where you left off.
canvas.noteHelp: Click the canvas and start writing.
canvas.connectTarget: Choose a note to connect it to
canvas.endPrivate: End private mode and reveal to everyone
canvas.privateModeHelp: Each participant sees their own notes. The facilitator decides when to reveal contributions.
canvas.sharedModeHelp: Everyone sees contributions. The facilitator can start private mode for everyone.

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.help: Explore one question at a time. Closing a round keeps notes editable and preserves their visibility.
rounds.empty: No rounds yet. You can keep brainstorming freely or prepare a round.
rounds.promptChanged: The session changed while you were editing. Compare the current question with your draft before replacing it.

timer.title: Timer
timer.help: Set time for the session. Everyone follows the same countdown.
timer.notifyOnly: Notify everyone. Other actions are optional.
timer.reveal: End private mode and reveal notes
timer.revealHelp: Available while private mode is active.
timer.closedHelp: New contributions are closed. Existing notes remain editable and your drafts are kept.

outcomes.skipped_authorization: Time ended. Automatic actions were skipped because facilitator access changed.
outcomes.skipped_configuration: Time ended. Automatic actions were skipped because the session settings changed.
outcomes.skipped_session: Time ended. Automatic actions were skipped because the session is no longer open.
